latestVersion.changelog:
Text to Video InVideo skill — initial release.

- Instantly converts text prompts or uploads into shareable AI-generated videos with voiceover and visuals.
- Supports TXT, DOCX, PDF, and raw text inputs up to 500MB.
- 1080p MP4 export, no manual video editing required.
- Automatic setup: free token and session are established on first use.
- Clear handling of common actions: upload, export, check credits, view project state.
- Built for fast, marketer-focused video creation workflows.
